Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 21, 2025

Chaos & Majesty values your privacy and keeps the data we collect to the minimum required to keep this site operational.

Information We Collect

  • Server logs: Our hosting provider may capture standard HTTP logs (IP address, user agent, timestamp) to protect the service and diagnose outages.
  • User submissions: If you send us a message or opt in to a feature that clearly asks for information, we keep only what is necessary to respond.
  • Local browser storage: We remember visual preferences (like theme selections) on your device. These values never leave your browser.

How We Use Information

  • Provide the static site experience and related content you request.
  • Protect, debug, and improve the reliability of the Chaos & Majesty platform.
  • Respond to inquiries you initiate.

We do not sell personal information, profile visitors, or run third-party advertising trackers.

Cookies and Local Storage

We do not place tracking cookies. Limited settings (for example, theme preferences) persist in localStorage or similar session-scoped storage so the site can remember your choices between visits on the same device. Clearing your browser data removes these values.

Data Retention

We keep server logs no longer than 30 days unless they are needed to investigate security issues. Messages you send may be retained while we work an open request and archived afterward to meet legal obligations.

Your Choices

  • Disable or clear local storage in your browser settings at any time.
  • Contact us to request corrections or deletion of information you previously provided.

Updates

We may revise this policy when our practices change. New versions replace prior ones when posted to this page. Material updates will include a clear notice on the site or via the communication channel you provided.

Warning! Chaosandmajesty.com accepts no responsibility for your interactions with WOPR.
